assessment: Optional exact Bok descriptor captures address/class/operator/deployer/salt/original constructor anchor. Actual SDK reconstruction binds init(board,operator,chain,version), complete original/current instance identity, original successful canonical receipt/effect/block, and anchored immutable board/operator/owner/chain/version storage.

Only exact configured Bok address and actual processed AccountingChanged ABI are decoded. Numeric bounds, state/trailer and conservation validated; reducer requires initial full WAITING allocation then retains absolute snapshots and closed/refunded history. Sequence is not incorrectly treated as a unique event counter. Existing chronological undo handles repeated changes in the same transaction.

Persistent acquisition extends the existing complete canonical block/effect scan, including empty and unrelated blocks; constructor transaction membership checked. Missing canonical data fails unavailable, never an empty complete balance. Original/current class and deployment anchors are rechecked. Reorg removes affected rows before readiness; cold reopen rebuilds and compares canonical history.

Uniform /api/bok-accounting accepts only limit/cursor, rejects owner, selected request IDs and duplicate parameters. No owner-dependent RPC acquisition or HTTP filter is introduced. Public request IDs are matched locally by the later wallet component.

Indexed numeric ascending keyset query examines at most limit+1 metadata rows, retains existing byte and row caps, and returns an opaque cursor authenticated to descriptor, exact revision/checkpoint, normalized parameters and session epoch. Consumers must collect all pages at the same revision before calling their local owned subset complete.
Bok descriptor participates in storage scope and cursor binding. Bootstrap chooses a distinct public-index-bok directory; old board-only cache is preserved and mismatched scope refuses reuse.

Bootstrap derives public descriptor only from the original deploy-escrow journal operation and reconciled constructor result. It recomputes the operator binding and complete deployment instance, rejects latest bind/register transaction substitution, and emits no private signed journal/actor fields. Existing normal loadRollingArtifacts runs before service construction.

Existing public-only checkpointed semantics remain. This component does not establish live wallet owned_requests coverage or finalized private withdrawal authority; those consumers must apply their original canonical/finality guards.
